lastCompletedStory.title: Adopt CLI tier aliases as the static model set (DEFAULTS + MODEL_OPTIONS + dogfood project.toml)

nextStoryContext: US-001 replaced DEFAULTS + MODEL_OPTIONS with CLI tier aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku/default/fable/opusplan/sonnet[1m]/opus[1m]); dated ids were dropped from the picker entirely because Select.tsx (src/ui/Select.tsx) has NO free-text entry mode -- it is a pure useInput arrow-key list over a fixed `options` array (confirmed by reading the component). This is exactly what US-002 (free-text 'custom / enter id' passthrough) needs to add: a new picker mode/row that lets the operator type an arbitrary model string (e.g. a dated snapshot id) instead of only choosing from MODEL_OPTIONS. readPhaseModel (src/config/models.ts) already returns ANY configured string verbatim with no allowlist -- confirmed by the new US-001 tests -- so the passthrough only needs a UI affordance in ConfigScreen.tsx/Select.tsx, no change to the config-read path. ADR-0034 (docs/adr/0034-...) already documents the alias-vs-dated trade-off and explicitly calls out 'free-text passthrough' as the intended mechanism for pinning a dated snapshot; US-002 is what actually implements it in the UI (US-001 only documented the trade-off in picker descriptions, per its own AC3, without adding a picker row for it).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed the exact CLI tier alias set and per-alias behavior table (default, best, fable, sonnet, opus, haiku, sonnet[1m], opus[1m], opusplan) used to build MODEL_OPTIONS; confirmed readPhaseModel's verbatim-passthrough design matches the CLI's own validation-at-spawn model (--model flag is not checked by Claude Code itself on non-Anthropic providers, and is only checked network-side on the Anthropic API).
